_comment: Reusable API-reference note blocks. Write a block once and apply it to many generated reference pages via the 'applies' globs (matched against the page's reference path, e.g. engine/reference/core/gpu/VirtualGPU). tools/extract_api.py injects matching blocks below the HUMAN-NOTES marker on every run. Use docroot-absolute links (/path.md) here because the same block lands on pages at varying depths. Per-page notes go in _notes/<subsystem>/<module>.md instead.
